STAT Specialty Hospital – Laredo North served lunch to officers with the Laredo Police Department as a show of appreciation for local law enforcement.

The hospital provided a homemade lunch to the officers, recognizing the men and women who serve and protect the Laredo community.

The gesture brought together healthcare professionals and law enforcement personnel, highlighting the relationship between two groups dedicated to serving Laredo residents.

The Police Department thanked STAT Specialty Hospital for its generosity and continued support, saying acts of kindness like these help strengthen the bond between officers and the community they serve.

Source: Hammrod News Laredo TX, November 9, 2026.
